import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B = im[...,0],im[...,1],im[...,2]
H,W,_=im.shape
def cls(r,g,b):
    if r>200 and g>200 and b>200: return '#'  # white
    if r>150 and 70<g<180 and b<100 and r-g>25 and g-b>15: return 'O' # orange
    if r>100 and r-g>45 and r-b>45: return 'R' # red
    if g>r+25 and g>b+20: return 'g' # green
    if b>r+25 and b>g+10: return 'b' # blue
    if abs(r-g)<25 and abs(g-b)<25:
        return '.' if r>120 else ':' # gray light/dark
    if r>g and g>b: return 't' # warm brown/tan
    return '?'
gy,gx=8,8
for y in range(0,H,gy):
    line=''
    for x in range(0,W,gx):
        block=im[y:y+gy,x:x+gx].reshape(-1,3)
        r,g,b=block.mean(0)
        line+=cls(r,g,b)
    print(f'{y:3d} '+line)
\""
